name: mstack-sharpen-prompt
description: Reframes and sharpens rough user prompts before sending them to an AI. Reads real workspace files when present, automatically selects reframe (problem-class disambiguation, impact-ranked domain vocabulary, cross-field analogies with break points, unmentioned concerns), sharpen (practitioner craft, rawer source inputs, named methods, objective external checks, empirical prototyping vs user-judgment split), or both together, and returns concise analysis plus one ready-to-send prompt in a single fenced block without executing the task. 100% offline with zero scripts, zero URLs and nothing to install. One skill for Claude Code, Codex and Antigravity.

interface.shortDescription: Offline prompt reframing and sharpening before an AI executes the task.
interface.longDescription: Turns rough prompts into sharper, better-framed prompts before execution. Reads real project files when present, selects reframe, sharpen, or both automatically, replaces vague adjectives with domain concepts, rawer inputs, specialist methods, and objective checks, stays strictly read-only, and offers to run the prompt only if you reply yes.
